SELECT r.revenue - c.cost AS gross_profit_2025,
       100.0 * (r.revenue - c.cost) / r.revenue AS gross_margin_pct
FROM (
  SELECT SUM(product_price) AS revenue
  FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items"
  WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01'
) AS r
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT SUM(order_cost) AS cost
  FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders"
  WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01'
) AS c
